resources.string: EyeU sees your screen, hears you, and does it for you.
Lets EyeU read what\'s on screen and tap, type, scroll and swipe on your behalf when you ask it to, using its accessibility permissions.
1. Allow EyeU to appear over other apps
This shows the small voice bar at the bottom of your screen, on top of any app.
2. Turn on the EyeU accessibility service
This lets EyeU read the screen and perform taps, swipes and typing for you.
EyeU listens only when you tap the mic button.

If no backend below is configured, EyeU still responds to simple commands ("go back", "open camera", "scroll down", "tap send") using an offline, on-device reader of what\'s on screen — it just can\'t plan multi-step or conditional tasks without a model.
